_comment: Copy to wayward-imagegen.config.json to use. Command-line flags and environment variables both win over this file.
_image_preset_note: Use 'anima' when you want a custom Anima checkpoint + character LoRA chain behind the normal Wayward image-generation route.
_prompt_affix_note: These are added around every incoming game prompt before the render is sent to ComfyUI.
_checkpoint_note: The shipped art was made with these. Anything else works but will not match the pictures you already have.
_speed_lora_note: Optional model-only speed LoRA. Leave empty to disable.
_character_loras_note: Character/style LoRAs are full model+clip LoRAs. For Anima this is usually the important part.
_character_profiles_note: Optional per-character LoRA and prompt mapping. The key should match Wayward character folder names such as elena, mara, pippa.
_limits_note: Bounds on what a runaway or hostile caller can do. maxDiskGb 0 means no ceiling.
_wan_note: Set this to an image-to-video workflow exported from ComfyUI in API format to enable video.
